sources.title: Llama Model Configurations | safety-research/circuit-tracer | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The Llama model configuration enables circuit tracing analysis on the Llama-3.2-1B model using ReLU-based transcoders. Unlike Gemma configurations which use L0 transcoders, the Llama setup uses ReLU transcoders trained with 131k dictionary size across 16 transformer layers.
